_notice: SAMPLE CAMPUS GRAPH DATA - Locations, distances, and coordinates are simulated sample data for prototype demonstration. They do not represent verified real-world survey or GPS measurements.

nodes.name: Main Campus Gate (Sample)
nodes.description: Tactile paving begins here. Security barrier and campus map tactile plaque.

nodes.name: Academic & Admin Block (Sample)
nodes.description: Lecture theatres 1-4, dean's office, registrar, and academic counseling.

nodes.name: Central Library (Sample)
nodes.description: Braille study section, audio workstations, step-free access via east ramp.

nodes.name: Turing CS & Engineering Hall (Sample)
nodes.description: Assistive computing lab, computer science lecture halls, ground floor entrance.

nodes.name: Student Activity Center (Sample)
nodes.description: Accessibility support desk, student organization rooms, lounge.

nodes.name: Campus Canteen & Dining (Sample)
nodes.description: Dining hall, wide order counter aisles, acoustic orientation beacon.

nodes.name: North Student Hostel (Sample)
nodes.description: Student residence halls, accessible ground-floor dormitories, night security desk.

nodes.name: Health & Wellness Center (Sample)
nodes.description: 24/7 campus first-aid clinic, pharmacy, step-free tactile ramp.

nodes.name: Athletics & Sports Complex (Sample)
nodes.description: Open ground, gymnasium, acoustic boundary markers.

edges.instructions: Follow the tactile paving straight for 130 meters toward Academic & Admin Block.
Bear slight right along the tree-lined path for 110 meters to the Campus Canteen entrance.
Head northwest along the residential pathway for 145 meters to reach North Student Hostel.
Proceed east along the garden walkway for 180 meters to the Library west plaza.
Proceed straight for 100 meters, then ascend a flight of 8 stairs leading to the Library plaza.
Follow the gently graded accessible ramp around the east garden to the Library entrance (195m, step-free).
Walk under the covered arcade walkway for 140 meters to reach the Computer Science Hall.
Head southeast across the central quad along the paved tactile path for 150 meters.
Head north along the tree-shaded pathway for 170 meters toward the Library entrance.
Walk northeast for 165 meters toward the CS Hall entrance.
Walk east along the canteen terrace walkway for 120 meters to the Student Activity Center.
Follow the tactile walkway east for 150 meters directly to the Health & Wellness Center.
Head south down the CS corridor path for 160 meters to the Health Center.
Head south toward the athletic fields for 200 meters. Pavement transitions to rubberized track near entrance.
